fact: On 19 November 2025 BlueOrchard's Microfinance Fund committed $7.5 million to Uganda-based fintech JUMO's asset-backed securitisation financing for MSME lending in Uganda, a structure first announced in June 2024 with Standard Bank as arranger and senior lender.
title: BlueOrchard managed fund invests $7.5 million in JUMO's venture to support entrepreneurs in Uganda
